parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The other record is a production computed property 'MetricRow.body' in the 'DebugPanel' package at 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift'. Merging these would couple the production DebugPanel component to demonstration-app semantics. The duplication is intentional: the sample app maintains its own local copy of DebugHUD to remain self-contained.
